source(output(
		CSCS_ID as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		TRN_ID as long,
		PREM_RATE_START_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		ASM as string,
		DETAIL as string,
		CSPI_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT DETAIL,SBSB_ID,GRGR_ID,CSCS_ID,CSPI_ID,ASM,PREM_RATE_START_DT,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SBSB_ID ) AS TRN_ID FROM [BOSS].[Letter].[PREM_CA_I_WS_IN]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBDETAIL
SRCOLEDBDETAIL sink(input(
		CSCS_ID as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		TRN_ID as long,
		PREM_RATE_START_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		ASM as string,
		DETAIL as string,
		CSPI_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CSCS_ID,
		GRGR_ID,
		TRN_ID,
		PREM_RATE_START_DT,
		SBSB_ID,
		ASM,
		DETAIL,
		CSPI_ID)) ~> DSTFFDETAIL
